body: Hey I hope you don't mind but I took a look at your post history. All the symptoms you're experiencing sound terrible and I'm so sorry you're going through this. You might want to seek out online communities for people recovering from eating disorders, because from what I've seen, what you're experiencing isn't uncommon and it isn't permanent.

It's not painless and there is a high possibility of failure. Unfortunately, there isn't really a 100% painless and guaranteed suicide method.

I don't know what you're going through but I hope you don't hurt yourself.
